name: Hime-sama, Ote Yawaraka ni!
original_name: 姫さまっ、お手やわらかに！
source:
One day, when Kenji enjoys a local festival with Chitose, Koko and Komomo, a girl, Pafin, suddenly bursts in saying, "I'll rule this town from now!" According to her, she is a direct descendant of the royal family. Will they be able to endure her ruling?

[From ErogeShop]
